responsibility: Provides rustc_ast’s attribute subsystem by defining and managing core attribute and meta-item data, including attribute ID allocation, query/accessor APIs over `Attribute`/`AttrItem`/`MetaItem` forms, parsing attribute tokens into structured meta items and literals, constructing common attribute and doc-comment AST nodes, and offering helper searches over attribute collections. Together, this module is the AST-layer interface for representing, interpreting, creating, and querying attributes.
